preconditions.name: wl_instrument_positive_control_separates
preconditions.description: leg 1: a constructed 2-token IncentiveTokenBank (this run's GoalConfig) yields a drive-favored most-wanted that DIFFERS from a designated last-consumed type -- the cross-target inequality the WL DV is built on, on a positive control.
preconditions.control: 2 deterministic probes: drive-favored most-wanted vs designated last-consumed (instrument-can-fire).

preconditions.name: run_bank_populated_two_tokens_differing_drive
preconditions.description: leg 2: per guard-passing seed the behavioural run's bank reached >= 2 distinct object tokens AND scored >= MIN_SCORED_STEPS consumption events with both targets defined AND per-axis-drive spread > floor (channels-written-this-run + drive GENUINELY VARIES -- so a zero delta is a real weakens, not a drive-pinned degenerate).
preconditions.control: fraction of guard-passing seeds with a populated, drive-differentiated bank at consumption events.

preconditions.name: raw_dissociation_nonvacuity
preconditions.description: gate (b2): the drive-favored dissociation fraction must itself exceed a non-vacuity floor so there ARE dissociations to attribute a drive-coupled delta to (guards a delta computed as a difference of two near-zeros).
preconditions.control: mean drive-favored dissociation fraction over guard-passing seeds.

criteria.name: C_WL_DRIVE_coupled_dissociation
criteria.definition: mean(WL_drive - WL_nodrive) >= max(K_SD*pstdev(delta), DELTA_FLOOR). The drive-uniform control subtracts the (N-1)/N baseline categorical mismatch; the residual is the drive's causal contribution. SD-of-DELTA (NOT SD-of-baseline) + absolute floor.

effect_size_gate.rationale: feedback_effect_size_pass_gate_margin: scale noise on pstdev(DELTA) (never pstdev(baseline_level), which collapses to ~0 on a reproducible substrate -> false supports) PLUS an absolute floor; a consistent delta collapses sd_delta so the FLOOR is load-bearing. k=1.0, FLOOR=0.15 pre-registered (user-chosen 2026-06-15).

contact_guard.definition: per-seed: P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4 (603n G2 + G3). A seed failing the guard is excluded from DV aggregation; < 2/3 seeds passing -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a false weakens. The leg is substrate-marginal (~0.4 +- noise, env layout default_rng(None)); a contact_guard_unmet self-route is a SUBSTRATE-CEILING foraging-axis finding (/implement-substrate), NOT a MECH-229 weakens.

wl_readiness_gate.definition: SAME-STATISTIC non-vacuity for the WL DV (the 514m/514n gap fix + the V3-EXQ-643 same-statistic lesson): leg 1 positive-control cross-target separation >= 1.0 AND leg 2 in-run bank populated >= 2 distinct tokens at differing per-axis drives on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. Confirms drive GENUINELY VARIES across scored steps so a zero delta is a real weakens. Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory), NEVER a false MECH-229 weakens.

drive_dependence_control.definition: WL_nodrive (drive-uniform most-wanted, per_axis_drive=None) is the within-eval drive-dependence control. In 514q it is LOAD-BEARING: the criterion is mean(WL_drive - WL_nodrive) under an effect-size gate, NOT the raw WL_drive fraction. This corrects the 514p/514o non-isolating raw-fraction criterion (whose drive-uniform negative control 0.717 itself cleared the 0.6 bar).

falsifier_offramp.definition: Pre-registered Woo/Spelke off-ramp (substrate_queue SD-049-PHASE-2 row-6). If (a)+(b)+(b2) met but (c) FAILs (a GENUINE weakens: drive varies, dissociations occur, yet the drive-coupled contribution does not clear the effect-size bar), the disambiguating follow-on is an OFF/bank-disabled control arm (wanting structurally == liking -> delta ~ 0) AND an n=5 OVERSHOOT arm. JOINT failure routes MECH-229 -> substrate_conditional with a V4-1 multi-agent-ecology dependency (clean exit). This run is the SD-049-on arm; off/control + overshoot queue only on a genuine weakens here. Re-evaluate the /claim-synthesis trigger if 514q also fails to discriminate on this fair test.
